chapterPlayback.description: Welcome to the first episode of NERD POKER: DUNGEONS AND DRAGONS WITH BRIAN POSEHN & FRIENDS! Join Brian Posehn as he engages in a weekly game of D&D with his funny friends Gerry Duggan (co-writer of Marvel’s Deadpool), Blaine Capatch (Comedy Central’s Beat the Geeks), Ken Daly (The Usual Suspects), Sarah Guzzardo (AvoidThisJob.com), and Dungeon Master Scott Robison (Mr. Sark). This week they explain the game of D&D, introduce their characters, and embark on their adventure aboard a pleasure cruise.
chapterPlayback.title: Let the Game Begin!

chapterPlayback.description: Get your dicks out America… the Dungeons & Dragons rollicking adventure continues. The group finds themselves stowed away on a pleasure cruise with swashbuckling hot chicks as their captors. The dimmest of the bunch, Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), volunteers to hurt someone and the group weighs whether they need a more stealth approach. Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), a half elf warlock, does reconnaissance with the dungeon master’s (Scott Robison) helpful world building. After gaining intel Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), Bartho Shett (Ken Daly), Ell Ryan (Gerry Duggan) and the rest of the gang weapon up. They’re an odd bunch, to be sure, but they work together to find out the truth of their surroundings. And Penn St. jokes happen. It’s a blast of fun and the story is only beginning.
chapterPlayback.title: Roll For Your Fate

chapterPlayback.description: More of the mysterious ship is unraveled as the gang moves forward in their adventure. Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), Bartho Shett (Ken Daly), Ell Ryan (Gerry Duggan) are lead by the dungeon master (Mr. Sark) as they search high and low for their gear. Will they take the stealthy route or go out guns blazing? Oh yeah, there will be nudity.
chapterPlayback.title: In Search of Gear

chapterPlayback.description: It’s time for the gang to rush, strike, and belch their way through a couple of guards as they continue their journey to find their gear! Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn) is first to deliver a devastating strike, Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch) sits back to decide what his next move will be, Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) wonders if they should take a guard hostage, Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) thinks cleaving rocks, Ell Ryan (Gerry Duggan) unleashes the wrath of winter, and dungeon master (Mr. Sark) guides them along the way. Plus, the gang recalls some crazy shit that happened on a previous D&D adventure featuring a Sir Robin Masters.
chapterPlayback.title: Let’s Get Ready To Rumble

chapterPlayback.description: A large rift has left the gang stranded on the sinking ship. Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn) and Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) must lash together the remaining wreckage to sail off into safety. Before they depart, Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), Bartho Shett (Ken Daly), and Ell Ryan (Gerry Duggan) explore the ship for food and supplies. What does the dungeon master (Mr. Sark) have in store for them next? Will they survive? Can the spirit bear swim? Listen to find out! Plus, the gang shares a coconut filled tale of a past shipfucked D&D adventure.
chapterPlayback.title: Shipwrecked

chapterPlayback.description: The sun has set and the gang has no choice other than to swim in the darkness toward the specs of light up ahead. Ell Ryan (Gerry Duggan) summons his spirit bear to gain an advantage while Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), and Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) paddle their way toward the light using the sail that Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) managed to rig. The dungeon master (Mr. Sark) will be their guide to what lies ahead in this pitch-dark night. Plus, the gang announces their alignments and tell us about Brian’s past D&D character, a pickle loving Jackie Chan.
chapterPlayback.title: Swim Toward The Light

chapterPlayback.description: The gang has no choice but to follow the whispers up ahead to find out what happened to Ell Ryan (Gerry Duggan). Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) takes action and dives underwater in search of Ell Ryan, Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch) tries to make out the whispered conversations to gather clues, Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn) stealthily swims towards the voices, and Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) is tired. All the while, the dungeon master (Mr. Sark) helps them advance by whispering as well. Plus, the gang takes us back to their past time traveling D&D adventure.
chapterPlayback.title: Follow the Whispers

chapterPlayback.description: With Ell Ryan’s (Gerry Duggan) disappearance, the gang decides to follow the survivors who have mistaken them for collectors. Ermine the survivor (Mr. Sark) guides Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), and Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) to their underwater sanctuary. Plus, Sark tells us a story about some crazy shit that happened to him regarding an espionage themed role playing game that still creeps Brian out to this day.
chapterPlayback.title: The Survivors

chapterPlayback.description: The gang decides to regroup back at the survivors’ underwater home to figure out a plan to infiltrate the collectors’ base. They learn about the connection with the Sea and Ell Ryan’s (Gerry Duggan) death as they talk to the Elder and decide to infiltrate the collectors’ base in the morning. Survivors Tras and Carn (Mr. Sark) join Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), and Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) on their mission to find out what lies inside the collector’s base. Plus, the gang recalls some memorable botches from past D&D adventures.
chapterPlayback.title: Going In Recons Blazing

chapterPlayback.description: Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), and Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) have successfully made it inside the collector’s base with the help of Tras and Carn (Mr. Sark). They’ve been careful not to get spotted until they reach the catwalk. Now they must roll to see if they can reach a running collector before he warns others of their presence. Will luck be on their side or will they roll botches? Plus, the gang makes a proposal to create a time capsule and recalls an old adventure featuring Gerry Duggan and a treasure guarding dragon. It will get filthy.
chapterPlayback.title: On The Catwalk

chapterPlayback.description: We have read all the useful tips on the forums and continue the battle with our new action points! Will Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), Bartho Shett, and Tras & Carn (Mr. Sark) prevail over these collectors or will they suffer another grueling curse of consecutive botches? Be sure to listen to find out! Plus, Sark remembers a precious moment from a past D&D adventure featuring Gerry Duggan, Chris Hardwick, and a goblin avalanche.
chapterPlayback.title: The Battle Continues

chapterPlayback.description: The gang finds themselves asking a gray robed man by the name of Shaunson (Mr. Sark) for directions to the control tower. Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn) & Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch) felt like they should have killed the guy while Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) & Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) stick to their choice of letting him go. They make it to the base of the docking tower and are left with the decision of continuing ahead or taking their chances going underneath. Get ready for some more drawings that look like dicks! Plus, the gang have some sweet remembrances of a cop D&D adventure that happened before Harry Potter existed.
chapterPlayback.title: Deeper Into The Base

chapterPlayback.description: Brian forgets his D&D gear so we are treated to listening to him call his babysitter to get all his character info. Then we get back to where we left off on the cargo lift as it goes straight up when suddenly, 3 pairs of feet are spotted across the lift. Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) decides to unleash his dragon breath on them, Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn) will follow up with a devastating strike, Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch) attacks with his dire radiance, and Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) stays back to keep an eye on their 2 hostages. Plus, Sark & the gang talk about the first time they saw Troll 2 in another edition of Sweet Sweet Days of Past.
chapterPlayback.title: Up Goes The Lift

chapterPlayback.description: Whispers are used as the gang finally stumbles upon the collector’s control room. While figuring out what their next move will be, Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn) & Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) surprise each other by switching roles and Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) & Carn (Mr. Sark) eagerly wait to see the possible action unfold near the 2 hostages. There will be ear plugging, tears and more of Blaine’s ads!
chapterPlayback.title: The Control Room

chapterPlayback.description: After the heated battle against the collectors, the gang tries to decipher the newly discovered maps covered in astronomical signals that they find on the tables around them. Then it quickly becomes an intimidation fest against their hostages that still remain in the elevator they rode in on. Will they have what it takes to intimidate these poor people? What do these strange maps mean? Which words remind Blaine of Bronson Pinchot? Tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: As The Dust Settles

chapterPlayback.description: Holy shit! The gang makes their way down the lift to find an open cell door with nothing but an eerie box filled with water. Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) investigates it, Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) worriedly questions Mildred’s actions, and Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn) & Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch) keep their distance as a shrill voice (Mr. Sark) from the box asks for their help. It’s the kind of episode that will possibly make you shit your pants. Plus, the gang calls out to the fans to help them get Vin Diesel on the show!
chapterPlayback.title: The Water Box

chapterPlayback.description: With their new found weapons and the help of their new ally Sparklett (Mr. Sark), will Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), Bartho Shett (Ken Daly), and Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch) be able to hold their own against the red robed collectors and bots that made their pal Ell Ryan (Gerry Duggan) disappear? You will have to tune in to find out! Plus, the gang recalls old adventures as they hop on the GNOME TRAIN!
chapterPlayback.title: Hack and Slash

chapterPlayback.description: The heat has finally gotten to our heros as they continue their heated battle against the remaining red robed collectors and clockwork men. Will they be able to cleave their way to victory? What happened to Sparklett? How much charisma does Blaine have? Listen to find out these answers and more! Plus, a special guest shows up for a segment called Dwarfaoke! This episode is brought to you by Calvin and Klein.
chapterPlayback.title: Finish The Fight!

chapterPlayback.description: Our heros have finally LEVELED UP! After they eradicated the squad of collector officers, Sparklett managed to reform with 4 more elemental friends. They must now continue their adventure by following Sparklett’s lead into the Water Elemental Plane and seal the breach before it’s too late. What will they come across in this new realm? Tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: Enter The Water Realm

chapterPlayback.description: The one-armed knight Sir Richard (Gerry Duggan) and co-prisoner Jayph (Mr. Sark) have joined Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Bartho Shett (Ken Daly), Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), and Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch) on their water quest. Now our heroes will burst into the control room of the ship where they found their new allies. Tune in to find out what lies ahead for them! Be sure to keep helping us with getting Vin Diesel to play D&D with us !
chapterPlayback.title: Burst Through and Kill

chapterPlayback.description: Hope is almost lost as Sparklett’s comrades have been discovered to be no more. However, our heroes still have a chance to seal the rift to the water elemental plane by taking Lord Noral’s crown. Using their newly enhanced wet suits, they will follow Sparklett to retrieve the crown and return to their own realm. It will be a battle for the ages!
chapterPlayback.title: Take The Lord’s Crown!

chapterPlayback.description: On a suicide escort mission with Sparklett, we join our heroes as they enter the 2nd round of their battle against Lord Noral and his army of guards. They’ve made it this far and must follow Sparklett’s directions to rest the crown from the Lord’s head to be able to seal the rift to the water elemental plane. It’s crunch time as every dice roll counts!
chapterPlayback.title: Locked In Combat

chapterPlayback.description: It’s anybody’s game as we return to the epic battle between our heroes and the now bloodied water elemental Lord Noral. The odds are against our heroes as they must deal with the giant serpent and protect their seized ally Sparklett. Will Lord Noral finally be annihilated or will his ice attacks crush them into oblivion? Tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: Anybody’s Game

chapterPlayback.description: Lord Noral seemed to have the upper hand as Sparklett sacrificed himself to save our heroes and Sir Richard met his demise under a ton of water. However, by some unknown power, a shining Sir Richard materializes with new glowing limbs and a look of determination on his face. Could this be the second wind our heroes need to finally end this battle? It’s an episode you won’t want to miss!
chapterPlayback.title: For Glinishmore and Bahamut!

chapterPlayback.description: In the aftermath of the final confrontation against Lord Noral, we join our heroes as they explore a new found ship. Familiarizing themselves with the inside of the ship, they stumble upon a couple of lockers that are etched with everyone’s names. Tune in to find out what kind of special trinkets these special lockers hold!
chapterPlayback.title: The Locker Gifts

chapterPlayback.description: Equipped with their dream weapons and with the guidance of their new friend Stargoyle, our heroes continue their quest! They eventually make the choice to arrive at what looks like to be a giant planet filled with gas. Seeing as they beat the Collectors to their destination, they use this extra time to rest while Blackee Green searches for rations. What sort of things inhabit this strange world? You’ll have to tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: A Whole New (Gassy) World

chapterPlayback.description: After making themselves familiar with this new planet and having some time to prep for the unknown force the Collectors have sent their way arrives, our heroes decide to test out their new gear. Things will get interesting and this time everyone makes sure that Brian doesn’t drift off.
chapterPlayback.title: Knocking Out

chapterPlayback.description: It appears that Mildred had suffered some strange affliction in the night that left her with a wound on her chest with 8 tiny little needle marks. Now our heroes will investigate their skiff to look for anything out of the ordinary. Maybe this time they’ll know better than to call it night without setting a watch.
chapterPlayback.title: Searching The Skiff

chapterPlayback.description: We’re now closer to figuring out what happened to Mildred as our heroes captured some of the skeletal chest crawlers and have locked them up aboard their ship. It’s gonna take some dissecting to uncover the mystery of these little monsters. Spoiler alert: Tacos will be eaten and there will be Game of Thrones talk.
chapterPlayback.title: Mystery of the Skeletal Crawler

chapterPlayback.description: The hunt for information on the skeletal crawlers continues as the gang figures out how to contact the Zyrax, the only species that holds that mystical knowledge. Zissou the Flutterer joins them as they fish for food to lure in the Zyrax when suddenly they hear a scream for help. It’s an episode that you won’t wanna miss complete with a chat about having babies and Brian googling blue waffles.
chapterPlayback.title: Feeding The Zyrax

chapterPlayback.description: Blaine (Blackee Green) returns just in time for the day the Collectors arrive. Sheathing swords, sharpening blades, and praying to Bahamut all occur in a bad ass montage as our adventurers prepare for what’s to come. Also, get ready for some dead on Bruce Willis impressions!
chapterPlayback.title: The Landing Day

chapterPlayback.description: After a long wait, the massive craft finally arrived to trade off clones of women that had been struck by the crawlers. Our heroes struck the plan to have Mildred sneak on the ship in place of her clone along with Sir Richard in disguise and find out what the Collectors are really up to. Will they be able to use their stealth to their advantage or fail by the dreaded botch? Tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: Sir Richard In Disguise

chapterPlayback.description: The gang has finally reunited and made their way onto the mother ship of the Collectors. They now face a choice to either hide before grabbing intel or going guns blazing. This spectacular episode also features Dungeon Master Mr. Sark as Sir Richard and a special appearance by The Fonz! Ayyy!
chapterPlayback.title: To Hide or Not To Hide

chapterPlayback.description: We’re off to follow the coordinates that our heroes have received with the help of Stargoyle on this week’s Nerd Poker! The coordinates lead them to the mysterious dark planet that orbits a giant red orb of a sun. You won’t believe what they find! Plus, we hear a couple of gems as the gang shares some of their best answering machine messages!
chapterPlayback.title: The Dark Planet

chapterPlayback.description: We join our heroes right where they left off, in a gigantic creepy black tower that is located on a planet covered in corpses. As they quickly make their way through the tower, they constantly run into flamboyant portraits of an older man. Who is this mysterious person? Have they stumbled upon his home? Tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: Inside the Black Tower

chapterPlayback.description: Hold on to your hats and glasses folks! Our heroes continue to explore further into the depths of the tower only to find out they are probably being watched. Stay tuned to find out what is in store for the gang and their thoughts on World War Z on this week’s thrilling episode of Nerd Poker!
chapterPlayback.title: We’re Gonna Have Company

chapterPlayback.description: The decision has been made to continue ascending the tower of death and shitty art on this week’s NERD POKER! What will our heroes find on their journey to the top? More importantly, what will Stargoyle find? Plus, a disaster of office proportions!
chapterPlayback.title: It’s A Long Way To The Top

chapterPlayback.description: It’s battle time as the gang plans their attack on this week’s NERD POKER! They’ve made it to the top of the tower and can’t go back. Will they be able to fight their way through what lies ahead? Pump up the battle music and tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: Battle Music

chapterPlayback.description: As Mildred awakens from her slumber, our heroes will try to the find the source of her strange behavior while Blackee Green quickly cycles through the tower screens in search of the mysterious old man. Plus, we find out if Sir Richard indeed has the skills to perform the perfect cartwheel!
chapterPlayback.title: Mildred Awakens

chapterPlayback.description: The time has come for our heroes to get back to their ship. But as they make it to the lift, they quickly find out that it may not be so easy to get to their destination. Just then, everyone assumes their bad ass battle positions because shit’s about to get real!
chapterPlayback.title: Going Back To The Choppa

chapterPlayback.description: Time is running out as our heroes continue to make their way back to the ship on this week’s NERD POKER! After making their way all the way to the top of this tower of terror, they’ll use their sky diving expertise in order to descend and go back to where they started. Will Mildred come to her senses? What sort of shenanigans does Stargoyle get into? Did the gang have a good time at their high school prom? Tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: Double Time

chapterPlayback.description: Finally onboard the ship, our heroes decide to fly over to the other side of the tower to explore and hopefully find the old man whose portraits hang on the walls of this soul filled place. Some crazy shit will definitely go down and the gang will figure out the 21st century versions of references that might be lost to younger listeners!
chapterPlayback.title: Other Side of the Tower

chapterPlayback.description: After blowing the roof off the place, the gang is back in the halls of the tower where they started. What will they stumble upon as they continue their search for this old necromancer? You’ll have to tune in to find out! Plus, everyone shares tales of early dungeon masters and Blaine discovers the triangle in the room.
chapterPlayback.title: Let’s Hop Out and Kill Grandpa

chapterPlayback.description: After boarding the detached tower escape vessel, the gang is back in the tower and Sir Richard has a spectacular roll. Things get weird fast as death by horse sex is mentioned almost immediately. Will the cliffhanger ever be addressed? You’ll have to tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: Limp Butt

chapterPlayback.description: Stargoyle is in the building! The gang continues their adventure in the tower by doing a lot of rope climbing but will one of them fall to their death into the empty chasm? Tune in to find out! Plus, a special surprise guest from the world of TRON drops by!
chapterPlayback.title: The Posehn Stroke

chapterPlayback.description: Now that Amarth resides with the likes of Slimer & Obi-Wan Kenobi, it’s time to see the addition of a new character. Will Brian’s new character piss off Gerry? You’ll have to tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: The New Guy

chapterPlayback.description: After retrieving the goods off Amarth’s mangled corpse, giving him a true Viking burial, and talking about Julie Andrew’s boobs, the rest of the gang continue the search for the old necromancer. Smashing their way through the tower’s rooms, they arrive in a large chamber where Sir Richard detects a mysterious evil presence.
chapterPlayback.title: The Big Chamber

chapterPlayback.description:
Brian is back and this time he means business. Creeping out of the shadows is Damien Wormwood Darkomen, a mysterious being from Melevania. Will he help our heroes in their quest to finally capture the old necromancer? Or does he have other intentions? Tune in to find out! Also, a new friend drops by!

Guests
chapterPlayback.title: Priest of Judas

chapterPlayback.description:
Last time we met with our adventurers they were trapped on a ship which was slowly tumbling toward the sun after finding the old necromancer’s bed chambers. To make matters worse, they accidentally activated a giant clockwork guard as they scoured the room. Will Dave Anthony be able to help them defeat this bot? You’ll have to tune in to find out! Plus, the gang goes down memory lane as they talk about their Halo LAN party days!

Guests
chapterPlayback.title: Battle Bot

chapterPlayback.description: The whole gang is back just in time to reunite with Blackie Green on the skiff they rode in on but they must hurry before their ship crash lands on the nearest star in space. Will they survive so that Sir Richard can punch Blackie Green for abandoning them? Tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: Through The Airlock

chapterPlayback.description: After Sir Richard gives Blackie a piece of his mind, the gang figures out what their next destination will be by using the star chart. Will they travel back to the Gas planet where a clone of Mildred awaits or will they finally visit Glinishmore? Tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: Star Chart

chapterPlayback.description: While on their trek to Glinishmore, the gang learns about Sir Richard’s mysterious past and get caught in an creepy situation.
chapterPlayback.title: I Would Walk 500 Miles

chapterPlayback.description: Soon after receiving a message from the mysterious young boy known as Parn, the gang follows him to his village where they hope to find supplies for their long journey to Glinishmore.
chapterPlayback.title: Parn’s Village

chapterPlayback.description: We find our heroes heading East toward the mountains as they hope to find crystals that will be able to power up their ship when suddenly Damien Darkomen hears the whisper of a wolf. Will the gang have to battle some wolves? Tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: Wolf Whisper

chapterPlayback.description: The gang is guided by Trondoor to the Dwarf fortress of Vex to prepare for the 7 Course Dwarf Feast and meet the King of the Dwarves.
chapterPlayback.title: 7 Course Dwarf Feast

chapterPlayback.description: Our heroes are locked in a battle against a giant reptilian monster to prove their nobility, honor, and prowess to the dwarves. Also, Sir Richard is still very drunk. Merry Christmas!
chapterPlayback.title: After Party Brawl

chapterPlayback.description: As the battle with the reptilian creature continues, it blindly attacks the dwarf guide Trondoor. Will our heroes be able to save him before he gets devoured? Tune in to find out and have a happy new year!
chapterPlayback.title: Saving Trondoor

chapterPlayback.description: Sark, Damien, Mildred, Blackie, Bartho, and Sir Richard are back and on their way to Glinishmore!
chapterPlayback.title: Change of Scenery

chapterPlayback.description: Our heroes take a shortcut to Glinishmore through some tunnels with the help of their trusty guide Trondoor. Expect some good Bruce Willis impressions.
chapterPlayback.title: The Tunnel to Glinishmore

chapterPlayback.description: As they continue through the underground passages, our heroes discover that the tunnels are infested with man rats and a battle ensues.
chapterPlayback.title: The Man Rats

chapterPlayback.description: Continuing their trek to Glinishmore, the gang hears a deafening scream coming from the newly entered cave which makes them curious. Is it a trap? Tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: The Scream in the Cave

chapterPlayback.description: Rats have made the walls collapse in the caves. The gang must figure out a way to continue to their destination of Glinishmore. Maybe Blackie Green’s new dwarf surfboard can help.
chapterPlayback.title: Dwarf Surfboard

chapterPlayback.description: After escaping the booby trapped cavern, our heroes investigate the remains of Sir Richard’s hot fury.
chapterPlayback.title: No Man Rat Left Behind

chapterPlayback.description: Continuing into the next series of tunnels, the sounds of very unsettling drums are heard by our heroes. What lies ahead for the gang? Will Sark bring up raves once again? Tune in to find out!
chapterPlayback.title: LED Hula Hoops

chapterPlayback.description:
The moment of truth is upon us. We join our heroes as they’re mere moments before a potentially fatal explosion deep within the cavern inhabited by the man rats. How will they prepare for the blast? Will they survive? Is this truly the end? Tune in to find out!

Covered in melted cheese is how we find our heroes now that they’ve been turned into rats. Will they find out who did this to them? Will they find out what happened to Sir Richard? Can they revert back to their old selves? Tune in to find out!

title: Nerd Poker

chapters.description: Welcome to the first episode of NERD POKER: DUNGEONS AND DRAGONS WITH BRIAN POSEHN & FRIENDS! Join Brian Posehn as he engages in a weekly game of D&D with his funny friends Gerry Duggan (co-writer of Marvel’s Deadpool), Blaine Capatch (Comedy Central’s Beat the Geeks), Ken Daly (The Usual Suspects), Sarah Guzzardo (AvoidThisJob.com), and Dungeon Master Scott Robison (Mr. Sark). This week they explain the game of D&D, introduce their characters, and embark on their adventure aboard a pleasure cruise.

segments.label: Nerd Poker #01 - Let the Game Begin!

chapters.title: Let the Game Begin!

chapters.description: Get your dicks out America… the Dungeons & Dragons rollicking adventure continues. The group finds themselves stowed away on a pleasure cruise with swashbuckling hot chicks as their captors. The dimmest of the bunch, Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), volunteers to hurt someone and the group weighs whether they need a more stealth approach. Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), a half elf warlock, does reconnaissance with the dungeon master’s (Scott Robison) helpful world building. After gaining intel Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), Bartho Shett (Ken Daly), Ell Ryan (Gerry Duggan) and the rest of the gang weapon up. They’re an odd bunch, to be sure, but they work together to find out the truth of their surroundings. And Penn St. jokes happen. It’s a blast of fun and the story is only beginning.

segments.label: Nerd Poker #02 - Roll For Your Fate

chapters.title: Roll For Your Fate

chapters.description: More of the mysterious ship is unraveled as the gang moves forward in their adventure. Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), Bartho Shett (Ken Daly), Ell Ryan (Gerry Duggan) are lead by the dungeon master (Mr. Sark) as they search high and low for their gear. Will they take the stealthy route or go out guns blazing? Oh yeah, there will be nudity.

segments.label: Nerd Poker #03 - In Search of Gear

chapters.title: In Search of Gear

chapters.description: It’s time for the gang to rush, strike, and belch their way through a couple of guards as they continue their journey to find their gear! Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn) is first to deliver a devastating strike, Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch) sits back to decide what his next move will be, Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) wonders if they should take a guard hostage, Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) thinks cleaving rocks, Ell Ryan (Gerry Duggan) unleashes the wrath of winter, and dungeon master (Mr. Sark) guides them along the way. Plus, the gang recalls some crazy shit that happened on a previous D&D adventure featuring a Sir Robin Masters.

segments.label: Nerd Poker #04 - Let’s Get Ready To Rumble

chapters.title: Let’s Get Ready To Rumble

chapters.description: A large rift has left the gang stranded on the sinking ship. Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn) and Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) must lash together the remaining wreckage to sail off into safety. Before they depart, Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), Bartho Shett (Ken Daly), and Ell Ryan (Gerry Duggan) explore the ship for food and supplies. What does the dungeon master (Mr. Sark) have in store for them next? Will they survive? Can the spirit bear swim? Listen to find out! Plus, the gang shares a coconut filled tale of a past shipfucked D&D adventure.
chapters.title: Shipwrecked

chapters.description: The sun has set and the gang has no choice other than to swim in the darkness toward the specs of light up ahead. Ell Ryan (Gerry Duggan) summons his spirit bear to gain an advantage while Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), and Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) paddle their way toward the light using the sail that Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) managed to rig. The dungeon master (Mr. Sark) will be their guide to what lies ahead in this pitch-dark night. Plus, the gang announces their alignments and tell us about Brian’s past D&D character, a pickle loving Jackie Chan.

segments.label: Nerd Poker #06 - Swim Toward The Light

chapters.title: Swim Toward The Light

chapters.description: The gang has no choice but to follow the whispers up ahead to find out what happened to Ell Ryan (Gerry Duggan). Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) takes action and dives underwater in search of Ell Ryan, Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch) tries to make out the whispered conversations to gather clues, Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn) stealthily swims towards the voices, and Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) is tired. All the while, the dungeon master (Mr. Sark) helps them advance by whispering as well. Plus, the gang takes us back to their past time traveling D&D adventure.
chapters.title: Follow the Whispers

chapters.description: With Ell Ryan’s (Gerry Duggan) disappearance, the gang decides to follow the survivors who have mistaken them for collectors. Ermine the survivor (Mr. Sark) guides Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), and Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) to their underwater sanctuary. Plus, Sark tells us a story about some crazy shit that happened to him regarding an espionage themed role playing game that still creeps Brian out to this day.
chapters.title: The Survivors

chapters.description: The gang decides to regroup back at the survivors’ underwater home to figure out a plan to infiltrate the collectors’ base. They learn about the connection with the Sea and Ell Ryan’s (Gerry Duggan) death as they talk to the Elder and decide to infiltrate the collectors’ base in the morning. Survivors Tras and Carn (Mr. Sark) join Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), and Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) on their mission to find out what lies inside the collector’s base. Plus, the gang recalls some memorable botches from past D&D adventures.

segments.label: Nerd Poker #09 - Going In Recons Blazing

chapters.title: Going In Recons Blazing

chapters.description: Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), and Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) have successfully made it inside the collector’s base with the help of Tras and Carn (Mr. Sark). They’ve been careful not to get spotted until they reach the catwalk. Now they must roll to see if they can reach a running collector before he warns others of their presence. Will luck be on their side or will they roll botches? Plus, the gang makes a proposal to create a time capsule and recalls an old adventure featuring Gerry Duggan and a treasure guarding dragon. It will get filthy.
chapters.title: On The Catwalk

chapters.description: We have read all the useful tips on the forums and continue the battle with our new action points! Will Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), Bartho Shett, and Tras & Carn (Mr. Sark) prevail over these collectors or will they suffer another grueling curse of consecutive botches? Be sure to listen to find out! Plus, Sark remembers a precious moment from a past D&D adventure featuring Gerry Duggan, Chris Hardwick, and a goblin avalanche.
chapters.title: The Battle Continues

chapters.description: The gang finds themselves asking a gray robed man by the name of Shaunson (Mr. Sark) for directions to the control tower. Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn) & Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch) felt like they should have killed the guy while Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) & Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) stick to their choice of letting him go. They make it to the base of the docking tower and are left with the decision of continuing ahead or taking their chances going underneath. Get ready for some more drawings that look like dicks! Plus, the gang have some sweet remembrances of a cop D&D adventure that happened before Harry Potter existed.

segments.label: Nerd Poker #12 - Deeper Into The Base

chapters.title: Deeper Into The Base

chapters.description: Brian forgets his D&D gear so we are treated to listening to him call his babysitter to get all his character info. Then we get back to where we left off on the cargo lift as it goes straight up when suddenly, 3 pairs of feet are spotted across the lift. Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) decides to unleash his dragon breath on them, Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn) will follow up with a devastating strike, Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch) attacks with his dire radiance, and Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) stays back to keep an eye on their 2 hostages. Plus, Sark & the gang talk about the first time they saw Troll 2 in another edition of Sweet Sweet Days of Past.

segments.label: Nerd Poker #13 - Up Goes The Lift

chapters.title: Up Goes The Lift

chapters.description: Whispers are used as the gang finally stumbles upon the collector’s control room. While figuring out what their next move will be, Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn) & Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) surprise each other by switching roles and Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch), Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) & Carn (Mr. Sark) eagerly wait to see the possible action unfold near the 2 hostages. There will be ear plugging, tears and more of Blaine’s ads!
chapters.title: The Control Room

chapters.description: After the heated battle against the collectors, the gang tries to decipher the newly discovered maps covered in astronomical signals that they find on the tables around them. Then it quickly becomes an intimidation fest against their hostages that still remain in the elevator they rode in on. Will they have what it takes to intimidate these poor people? What do these strange maps mean? Which words remind Blaine of Bronson Pinchot? Tune in to find out!

segments.label: Nerd Poker #15 - As The Dust Settles

chapters.title: As The Dust Settles

chapters.description: Holy shit! The gang makes their way down the lift to find an open cell door with nothing but an eerie box filled with water. Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo) investigates it, Bartho Shett (Ken Daly) worriedly questions Mildred’s actions, and Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn) & Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch) keep their distance as a shrill voice (Mr. Sark) from the box asks for their help. It’s the kind of episode that will possibly make you shit your pants. Plus, the gang calls out to the fans to help them get Vin Diesel on the show!
chapters.title: The Water Box

chapters.description: With their new found weapons and the help of their new ally Sparklett (Mr. Sark), will Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), Bartho Shett (Ken Daly), and Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch) be able to hold their own against the red robed collectors and bots that made their pal Ell Ryan (Gerry Duggan) disappear? You will have to tune in to find out! Plus, the gang recalls old adventures as they hop on the GNOME TRAIN!
chapters.title: Hack and Slash

chapters.description: The heat has finally gotten to our heros as they continue their heated battle against the remaining red robed collectors and clockwork men. Will they be able to cleave their way to victory? What happened to Sparklett? How much charisma does Blaine have? Listen to find out these answers and more! Plus, a special guest shows up for a segment called Dwarfaoke! This episode is brought to you by Calvin and Klein.
chapters.title: Finish The Fight!

chapters.description: Our heros have finally LEVELED UP! After they eradicated the squad of collector officers, Sparklett managed to reform with 4 more elemental friends. They must now continue their adventure by following Sparklett’s lead into the Water Elemental Plane and seal the breach before it’s too late. What will they come across in this new realm? Tune in to find out!

segments.label: Nerd Poker #19 - Enter The Water Realm

chapters.title: Enter The Water Realm

chapters.description: The one-armed knight Sir Richard (Gerry Duggan) and co-prisoner Jayph (Mr. Sark) have joined Amarth Amon (Brian Posehn), Bartho Shett (Ken Daly), Mildred Maxton (Sarah Guzzardo), and Blackee Green (Blaine Capatch) on their water quest. Now our heroes will burst into the control room of the ship where they found their new allies. Tune in to find out what lies ahead for them! Be sure to keep helping us with getting Vin Diesel to play D&D with us !

segments.label: Nerd Poker #20 - Burst Through and Kill

chapters.title: Burst Through and Kill

chapters.description: Hope is almost lost as Sparklett’s comrades have been discovered to be no more. However, our heroes still have a chance to seal the rift to the water elemental plane by taking Lord Noral’s crown. Using their newly enhanced wet suits, they will follow Sparklett to retrieve the crown and return to their own realm. It will be a battle for the ages!

segments.label: Nerd Poker #21 - Take The Lord’s Crown!

chapters.title: Take The Lord’s Crown!

chapters.description: On a suicide escort mission with Sparklett, we join our heroes as they enter the 2nd round of their battle against Lord Noral and his army of guards. They’ve made it this far and must follow Sparklett’s directions to rest the crown from the Lord’s head to be able to seal the rift to the water elemental plane. It’s crunch time as every dice roll counts!
chapters.title: Locked In Combat

chapters.description: It’s anybody’s game as we return to the epic battle between our heroes and the now bloodied water elemental Lord Noral. The odds are against our heroes as they must deal with the giant serpent and protect their seized ally Sparklett. Will Lord Noral finally be annihilated or will his ice attacks crush them into oblivion? Tune in to find out!
chapters.title: Anybody’s Game

chapters.description: Lord Noral seemed to have the upper hand as Sparklett sacrificed himself to save our heroes and Sir Richard met his demise under a ton of water. However, by some unknown power, a shining Sir Richard materializes with new glowing limbs and a look of determination on his face. Could this be the second wind our heroes need to finally end this battle? It’s an episode you won’t want to miss!

segments.label: Nerd Poker #24 - For Glinishmore and Bahamut!

chapters.title: For Glinishmore and Bahamut!

chapters.description: In the aftermath of the final confrontation against Lord Noral, we join our heroes as they explore a new found ship. Familiarizing themselves with the inside of the ship, they stumble upon a couple of lockers that are etched with everyone’s names. Tune in to find out what kind of special trinkets these special lockers hold!
chapters.title: The Locker Gifts

chapters.description: Equipped with their dream weapons and with the guidance of their new friend Stargoyle, our heroes continue their quest! They eventually make the choice to arrive at what looks like to be a giant planet filled with gas. Seeing as they beat the Collectors to their destination, they use this extra time to rest while Blackee Green searches for rations. What sort of things inhabit this strange world? You’ll have to tune in to find out!

segments.label: Nerd Poker #26 - A Whole New (Gassy) World

chapters.title: A Whole New (Gassy) World

chapters.description: After making themselves familiar with this new planet and having some time to prep for the unknown force the Collectors have sent their way arrives, our heroes decide to test out their new gear. Things will get interesting and this time everyone makes sure that Brian doesn’t drift off.
chapters.title: Knocking Out

chapters.description: It appears that Mildred had suffered some strange affliction in the night that left her with a wound on her chest with 8 tiny little needle marks. Now our heroes will investigate their skiff to look for anything out of the ordinary. Maybe this time they’ll know better than to call it night without setting a watch.
chapters.title: Searching The Skiff

chapters.description: We’re now closer to figuring out what happened to Mildred as our heroes captured some of the skeletal chest crawlers and have locked them up aboard their ship. It’s gonna take some dissecting to uncover the mystery of these little monsters. Spoiler alert: Tacos will be eaten and there will be Game of Thrones talk.

segments.label: Nerd Poker #29 - Mystery of the Skeletal Crawler

chapters.title: Mystery of the Skeletal Crawler

chapters.description: The hunt for information on the skeletal crawlers continues as the gang figures out how to contact the Zyrax, the only species that holds that mystical knowledge. Zissou the Flutterer joins them as they fish for food to lure in the Zyrax when suddenly they hear a scream for help. It’s an episode that you won’t wanna miss complete with a chat about having babies and Brian googling blue waffles.
chapters.title: Feeding The Zyrax

chapters.description: Blaine (Blackee Green) returns just in time for the day the Collectors arrive. Sheathing swords, sharpening blades, and praying to Bahamut all occur in a bad ass montage as our adventurers prepare for what’s to come. Also, get ready for some dead on Bruce Willis impressions!
chapters.title: The Landing Day

chapters.description: After a long wait, the massive craft finally arrived to trade off clones of women that had been struck by the crawlers. Our heroes struck the plan to have Mildred sneak on the ship in place of her clone along with Sir Richard in disguise and find out what the Collectors are really up to. Will they be able to use their stealth to their advantage or fail by the dreaded botch? Tune in to find out!

segments.label: Nerd Poker #32 - Sir Richard In Disguise

chapters.title: Sir Richard In Disguise

chapters.description: The gang has finally reunited and made their way onto the mother ship of the Collectors. They now face a choice to either hide before grabbing intel or going guns blazing. This spectacular episode also features Dungeon Master Mr. Sark as Sir Richard and a special appearance by The Fonz! Ayyy!

segments.label: Nerd Poker #33 - To Hide or Not To Hide

chapters.title: To Hide or Not To Hide

chapters.description: We’re off to follow the coordinates that our heroes have received with the help of Stargoyle on this week’s Nerd Poker! The coordinates lead them to the mysterious dark planet that orbits a giant red orb of a sun. You won’t believe what they find! Plus, we hear a couple of gems as the gang shares some of their best answering machine messages!
chapters.title: The Dark Planet

chapters.description: We join our heroes right where they left off, in a gigantic creepy black tower that is located on a planet covered in corpses. As they quickly make their way through the tower, they constantly run into flamboyant portraits of an older man. Who is this mysterious person? Have they stumbled upon his home? Tune in to find out!

segments.label: Nerd Poker #35 - Inside the Black Tower

chapters.title: Inside the Black Tower

chapters.description: Hold on to your hats and glasses folks! Our heroes continue to explore further into the depths of the tower only to find out they are probably being watched. Stay tuned to find out what is in store for the gang and their thoughts on World War Z on this week’s thrilling episode of Nerd Poker!

segments.label: Nerd Poker #36 - We’re Gonna Have Company

chapters.title: We’re Gonna Have Company

chapters.description: The decision has been made to continue ascending the tower of death and shitty art on this week’s NERD POKER! What will our heroes find on their journey to the top? More importantly, what will Stargoyle find? Plus, a disaster of office proportions!

segments.label: Nerd Poker #37 - It’s A Long Way To The Top

chapters.title: It’s A Long Way To The Top

chapters.description: It’s battle time as the gang plans their attack on this week’s NERD POKER! They’ve made it to the top of the tower and can’t go back. Will they be able to fight their way through what lies ahead? Pump up the battle music and tune in to find out!
chapters.title: Battle Music

chapters.description: As Mildred awakens from her slumber, our heroes will try to the find the source of her strange behavior while Blackee Green quickly cycles through the tower screens in search of the mysterious old man. Plus, we find out if Sir Richard indeed has the skills to perform the perfect cartwheel!
chapters.title: Mildred Awakens

chapters.description: The time has come for our heroes to get back to their ship. But as they make it to the lift, they quickly find out that it may not be so easy to get to their destination. Just then, everyone assumes their bad ass battle positions because shit’s about to get real!

segments.label: Nerd Poker #40 - Going Back To The Choppa

chapters.title: Going Back To The Choppa

chapters.description: Time is running out as our heroes continue to make their way back to the ship on this week’s NERD POKER! After making their way all the way to the top of this tower of terror, they’ll use their sky diving expertise in order to descend and go back to where they started. Will Mildred come to her senses? What sort of shenanigans does Stargoyle get into? Did the gang have a good time at their high school prom? Tune in to find out!
chapters.title: Double Time

chapters.description: Finally onboard the ship, our heroes decide to fly over to the other side of the tower to explore and hopefully find the old man whose portraits hang on the walls of this soul filled place. Some crazy shit will definitely go down and the gang will figure out the 21st century versions of references that might be lost to younger listeners!

segments.label: Nerd Poker #42 - Other Side of the Tower

chapters.title: Other Side of the Tower

chapters.description: After blowing the roof off the place, the gang is back in the halls of the tower where they started. What will they stumble upon as they continue their search for this old necromancer? You’ll have to tune in to find out! Plus, everyone shares tales of early dungeon masters and Blaine discovers the triangle in the room.

segments.label: Nerd Poker #43 - Let’s Hop Out and Kill Grandpa

chapters.title: Let’s Hop Out and Kill Grandpa

chapters.description: After boarding the detached tower escape vessel, the gang is back in the tower and Sir Richard has a spectacular roll. Things get weird fast as death by horse sex is mentioned almost immediately. Will the cliffhanger ever be addressed? You’ll have to tune in to find out!
chapters.title: Limp Butt

chapters.description: Stargoyle is in the building! The gang continues their adventure in the tower by doing a lot of rope climbing but will one of them fall to their death into the empty chasm? Tune in to find out! Plus, a special surprise guest from the world of TRON drops by!
chapters.title: The Posehn Stroke

chapters.description: Now that Amarth resides with the likes of Slimer & Obi-Wan Kenobi, it’s time to see the addition of a new character. Will Brian’s new character piss off Gerry? You’ll have to tune in to find out!
chapters.title: The New Guy

chapters.description: After retrieving the goods off Amarth’s mangled corpse, giving him a true Viking burial, and talking about Julie Andrew’s boobs, the rest of the gang continue the search for the old necromancer. Smashing their way through the tower’s rooms, they arrive in a large chamber where Sir Richard detects a mysterious evil presence.
chapters.title: The Big Chamber

chapters.description:
Brian is back and this time he means business. Creeping out of the shadows is Damien Wormwood Darkomen, a mysterious being from Melevania. Will he help our heroes in their quest to finally capture the old necromancer? Or does he have other intentions? Tune in to find out! Also, a new friend drops by!

Guests
chapters.title: Priest of Judas

chapters.description:
Last time we met with our adventurers they were trapped on a ship which was slowly tumbling toward the sun after finding the old necromancer’s bed chambers. To make matters worse, they accidentally activated a giant clockwork guard as they scoured the room. Will Dave Anthony be able to help them defeat this bot? You’ll have to tune in to find out! Plus, the gang goes down memory lane as they talk about their Halo LAN party days!

Guests
chapters.title: Battle Bot

chapters.description: The whole gang is back just in time to reunite with Blackie Green on the skiff they rode in on but they must hurry before their ship crash lands on the nearest star in space. Will they survive so that Sir Richard can punch Blackie Green for abandoning them? Tune in to find out!
chapters.title: Through The Airlock

chapters.description: After Sir Richard gives Blackie a piece of his mind, the gang figures out what their next destination will be by using the star chart. Will they travel back to the Gas planet where a clone of Mildred awaits or will they finally visit Glinishmore? Tune in to find out!
chapters.title: Star Chart

chapters.description: While on their trek to Glinishmore, the gang learns about Sir Richard’s mysterious past and get caught in an creepy situation.

segments.label: Nerd Poker #52 - I Would Walk 500 Miles

chapters.title: I Would Walk 500 Miles

chapters.description: Soon after receiving a message from the mysterious young boy known as Parn, the gang follows him to his village where they hope to find supplies for their long journey to Glinishmore.
chapters.title: Parn’s Village

chapters.description: We find our heroes heading East toward the mountains as they hope to find crystals that will be able to power up their ship when suddenly Damien Darkomen hears the whisper of a wolf. Will the gang have to battle some wolves? Tune in to find out!
chapters.title: Wolf Whisper

chapters.description: The gang is guided by Trondoor to the Dwarf fortress of Vex to prepare for the 7 Course Dwarf Feast and meet the King of the Dwarves.
chapters.title: 7 Course Dwarf Feast

chapters.description: Our heroes are locked in a battle against a giant reptilian monster to prove their nobility, honor, and prowess to the dwarves. Also, Sir Richard is still very drunk. Merry Christmas!
chapters.title: After Party Brawl

chapters.description: As the battle with the reptilian creature continues, it blindly attacks the dwarf guide Trondoor. Will our heroes be able to save him before he gets devoured? Tune in to find out and have a happy new year!
chapters.title: Saving Trondoor

chapters.description: Sark, Damien, Mildred, Blackie, Bartho, and Sir Richard are back and on their way to Glinishmore!
chapters.title: Change of Scenery

chapters.description: Our heroes take a shortcut to Glinishmore through some tunnels with the help of their trusty guide Trondoor. Expect some good Bruce Willis impressions.

segments.label: Nerd Poker #59 - The Tunnel to Glinishmore

chapters.title: The Tunnel to Glinishmore

chapters.description: As they continue through the underground passages, our heroes discover that the tunnels are infested with man rats and a battle ensues.
chapters.title: The Man Rats

chapters.description: Continuing their trek to Glinishmore, the gang hears a deafening scream coming from the newly entered cave which makes them curious. Is it a trap? Tune in to find out!

segments.label: Nerd Poker #61 - The Scream in the Cave

chapters.title: The Scream in the Cave

chapters.description: Rats have made the walls collapse in the caves. The gang must figure out a way to continue to their destination of Glinishmore. Maybe Blackie Green’s new dwarf surfboard can help.
chapters.title: Dwarf Surfboard

chapters.description: After escaping the booby trapped cavern, our heroes investigate the remains of Sir Richard’s hot fury.

segments.label: Nerd Poker #63 - No Man Rat Left Behind

chapters.title: No Man Rat Left Behind

chapters.description: Continuing into the next series of tunnels, the sounds of very unsettling drums are heard by our heroes. What lies ahead for the gang? Will Sark bring up raves once again? Tune in to find out!
chapters.title: LED Hula Hoops

chapters.description:
The moment of truth is upon us. We join our heroes as they’re mere moments before a potentially fatal explosion deep within the cavern inhabited by the man rats. How will they prepare for the blast? Will they survive? Is this truly the end? Tune in to find out!

chapters.description:
After last week’s life changing episode, we check in to see what fate has chosen for our heroes. Spoiler alert: rats are involved.

chapters.title: A New Awakening

chapters.description:
Covered in melted cheese is how we find our heroes now that they’ve been turned into rats. Will they find out who did this to them? Will they find out what happened to Sir Richard? Can they revert back to their old selves? Tune in to find out!

This episode is sponsored by Hulu Plus. Go to www.huluplus.com/nerd for an extended 2 week free trial.
chapters.title: Rat Trap

chapters.description:
After leveling up, the gang is one step closer to returning to their former selves as they await to receive a special poison from Bruce the rat that will help them defeat Gnasher the dog. Will they succeed? Tune in to find out!

chapters.description:
With the new found ability to be invisible, the gang keep an eye on the deadly Gnasher to see if it falls to its death after drinking from its poisoned water bowl. Will the dog meet its demise? Where is that faint harp noise coming from? Tune in to find out!

chapters.description:
The rat pack has found themselves in the kitchen as they are onto their next mission to poison the Shaman of the Man Rats. Will they able to finally break the curse? Tune in to find out!

chapters.description:
With the curse lifted, the gang help the dwarves in a battle against the Man Rats that kept them captive. Spoiler alert: These Man Rats are going to get the shit kicked out of them.
